During the [[Galactic War]], the [[Hero of Tython]] and crew went on a '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] to aid the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Leeha Narezz]] in the search for the plans to the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] [[Emperor's Fortress|space station]]. Working with [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Fideltin Rusk]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military's]] [[301st Infantry]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] fought the forces of both the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] organization across the icy surface of the planet in search of first the [[Deference|downed shuttle]] believed to contain the plans, and then the shuttle's databank after it was stolen by the pirates. While the Hero and Rusk defeated the [[Gen'Dai/Legends|Gen'Dai]] [[Zeshatt]] and the [[Imperial Guard|Emperor's Guardsman]] [[Lassicar]] in two separate engagements, Leeha Narezz successfully retrieved the databank, allowing the [[Jedi strike team (capture of the Sith Emperor)|Jedi strike team]] to proceed with their [[Mission to the Emperor's Fortress|mission]] to capture the Emperor.
